description: English product review meeting with 2 speakers, 1 decision, and 2 action items.

segments.speaker: Alice
segments.text: Good morning Bob, let's review the Q3 product deliverables.

segments.speaker: Bob
segments.text: Good morning Alice, we passed the initial security compliance checks yesterday.

segments.speaker: Alice
segments.text: That is great news. We decided to approve the single sign-on integration for the enterprise tier.

segments.speaker: Bob
segments.text: Excellent. I will finalize the OAuth documentation by Friday.

segments.speaker: Alice
segments.text: And I will schedule the staging deployment by next Tuesday.
